blends.name: Blending 3 x #2 - Raven Sticker to $RAVEN Drop #2 - Robot Dance
blends.desc:
**This is the blending for 2 x #3 - RAVEN stickers to one $RAVEN Drop #2 - Robot Dance pack**

About the packs:

We are proud to announce the biggest NFT drop featuring a brand new Raven song! 
But this is not just a song NFT drop.
To be able to get the song, you first need to collect all stems of the song to blend them together to the final NFT and song!
That means, you have to collect all 6 body parts of Robo Raven to build the final robot. :)

These 6 parts are:
#1 - Soul (vocal stem of the song)
#2 - Body (main synths stem of the song)
#3 - Harmony Complemtent (harmony synths stem of the song)
#4 - Melody Complement (melody synths stem of the song)
#5 - Rational Base (drum stem of the song)
#6 - Emotional Base (kick and bass stem of the song)

Once you have one of each 6 parts, you will be able to blend and get the special song NFT.

**This pack will include the following NFTs:**
* 2 random parts of the above mentioned
	* every part has the same drop chance
* 1 sticker
	* there are 3 different stickers with the following drop chances:
		* #1 Thila - 40%
		* #2 Ravazzo - 40%
		* #3 Raven - 20%
* If you are lucky you get 1 bonus animated companion  NFT with the following drop chances:
		* #1 Thila - 15%
		* #2 Ravazzo - 15%

The stickers can be used to blend into a new free pack.
You either need 3 x #1 Thila or 3 x #2 Ravazzo or 2 x #3 Raven stickers for that.


Robo Raven, Thila and Ravazzo were drawn by the incredible artist  **CreepyArts**. Please look at her art and show her some love by giving a follow on her Instagram account: https://www.instagram.com/creepyarts/
The NFTs were animated by Raven herself and **Lavinia**. Please also have a look at that great music and video artist: https://www.instagram.com/lavinia.gerster/
The song has been produced and mixed by Raven.


Now we wish you lot´s of fun opening the packs and the best of luck! :)

RAVEN


If you wanna know more about this drop or Raven´s art and music, join our Discord server "The Reign of the Raven Queen" https://discord.gg/Gw33rwqd5V.

Interested in becoming a $RAVEN holder yourself to get free NFT drops? Read about it here: https://peakd.com/token/@ravenmus1c/the-official-token-sale-of-ravencoin-starts-now
